ns2:section.sectionText: This section is primarily for students in the new EOL cohort who will begin their program of student in the fall 2005 semester. However, continuing EOL students that need the course can enroll in the sections also. Class meetings are Fridays 6:00 to 9:00 PM and Saturdays 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM; class meets on Sept 16 & 17, Oct 7 & 8, Nov 4 & 5 and 18 & 19, and Dec 9 & 10. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu.
